faq.q: How do I know if I or a loved one needs a hearing test?
faq.a: Common signs include asking people to frequently repeat themselves, turning TV volume higher than others prefer, struggling to follow group conversations or hearing in noisy areas, and ringing or buzzing sounds in the ears. A simple, painless computerized hearing assessment at Devi Care will provide clarity.

faq.q: Are the hearing aids visible when worn?
faq.a: Not at all! As noted in patient reviews, we specialize in miniature Completely-in-Canal (CIC) and Invisible-in-Canal (IIC) digital hearing aids that sit deep inside your ear canal and look like tiny earpods or are completely invisible from the front.

faq.q: Can I test or trial a hearing aid before purchasing?
faq.a: Yes! At Devi Care, we believe you should experience the difference for yourself. We provide personalized hearing aid demonstrations and trials so you can feel the sound clarity and physical comfort prior to making your decision.

faq.q: What conditions are treated in speech therapy?
faq.a: Our speech-language pathology services help children with developmental speech delays, autism spectrum communication needs, and pronunciation difficulties, as well as adults with stuttering/stammering, voice strain, or recovery following vocal issues.

faq.q: Do I need an appointment before visiting?
faq.a: While walk-ins are welcomed during clinic hours, we recommend calling or messaging us on WhatsApp (+91 88855 57633) in advance to reserve your preferred consultation slot without waiting.
